verdict.rationale: MX publishes a formal OpenAPI specification (mx-gh-1, mx-docs-12/26/31) documenting request/response schemas, offers webhooks for event-driven consumption (mx-docs-7/22/41), structured endpoints for balances/transactions/owner info (mx-docs-2/4/5/6/18/19/20), and even an official MCP server for agent access (mx-probe-3), plus data-driven intelligence/personalized insight features (mx-docs-13/14/27) suggesting enrichment beyond raw data. Missing for 10: concrete example JSON payloads/categorization schema documentation and independent verification that the data is heuristic-free/agent-ready in practice.
